summary.interpretation: C3 evidence, two independent problems: (1) the loaders used to do a bare pickle.load on zlib-compressed bytes and required an artifact_hash that metadata.json never wrote - both now fixed in ml/artifacts.py, ml/model_loader.py and services/inference_service.py; (2) the pickle streams stored in ml_artifacts/ are themselves corrupt, and no writer for that layout exists in this repository (no zlib call anywhere in the Python sources), so the files were produced by an external toolchain and must be regenerated. See reports/c3_roundtrip.json for the proof that the loader path itself now works end-to-end.
